title: content/climate.yaml — terrain transition table + climate tuning rates (D4/D10)
description: The single owner of climate DATA (docs/climate.md RESOLVED #4). Two blocks: `transitions` (from-type × condition-Formula → to-type, the §6-DSL-driven dynamic-terrain rules consumed by engine/climate.Rules) and `balance` (rate-only tuning constants, D9 spirit). The 10-day-expected / 30-day-forced / 2-12h-duration SHAPE is fixed design and lives in engine code, NOT here — only the rates below are tunable. platform/config compiles this into climate.Rules + climate.Config and cross-checks every `from`/`to` against content/terrain.yaml (an undefined terrain id is a load-time failure, D10).

grid.description: Coarse climate-grid geometry (RESOLVED #1: one climate cell spans many navmap cells). Injected into climate.Config.GridCols/GridRows.

initial_moisture.description: Optional default starting Moisture for every cell; defaults to 0.5 when absent.

initial_temperature.description: Optional default starting Temperature for every cell; defaults to 0.5 when absent.

transitions.description: The from-type × condition → to-type transition table (D4/D10). Order is SIGNIFICANT: for a given `from`, the FIRST rule whose `when` Formula is true wins (deterministic, D12). An empty array = climate-off (outcome-neutral introduction phase, RESOLVED #10). Every `from`/`to` MUST be a terrain id defined in content/terrain.yaml (platform/config validates).

balance.description: Rate-only tuning injected into climate.Config (D9 spirit: rates are content, the SHAPE is fixed design). The fixed-design hard values (hard-cap 720h, duration 2-12h) are carried here ONLY so engine code stays literal-free (D10); they are not free design knobs.

rain_prob_per_hour.description: Per-game-hour increment to PRain, calibrated so E[first rain] ≈ 10 days = 240 game-hours (1a).

rain_hard_cap_hours.description: Forced rain after this many dry game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 720 (30 days); injected to keep engine literal-free (D10).

rain_dur_min_hours.description: Rain duration lower bound in game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 2 (1a).

rain_dur_max_hours.description: Rain duration upper bound in game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 12 (1a); must be ≥ rain_dur_min_hours.

moisture_rain_rate.description: Moisture gained per game-hour while raining (1a).

evap_base_rate.description: Base Moisture lost per dry game-hour (1a).

evap_temp_scale.description: Extra Moisture lost per dry game-hour per unit Temperature — the Temperature→Moisture feedback (1a).

temp_day_peak.description: Temperature at the daily peak (midday), normalized (1b).

temp_night_low.description: Temperature at the daily trough (night), normalized; must be ≤ temp_day_peak (1b).

terrainId.description: A terrain type id; must exist in content/terrain.yaml (cross-checked by platform/config, D10).

when.description: A §6 Formula boolean condition over CellState operands `moisture` and `temperature` (both in [0,1]), e.g. "moisture > 0.7" or "moisture < 0.2 & temperature > 0.6". Compiled + validated by platform/config via the shared engine/core Formula evaluator; an undefined operand is a load-time failure (D10/design.md §6). No RNG inside a condition (deterministic, D12).
